plain: Speech that insults God or sacred things

webster.text: An indignity offered to God by words or writing; reproachful, contemptuous or irreverent words uttered impiously against Jehovah.

more.text: That which derogates from the prerogatives of God.

example.quote: In their statute-book is a law against such as speak disrespectfully of him, who are to be punished in the same manner as those convicted of blasphemy.
example.cite: John Adams, A Defence of the Constitutions of Government of the United States of America, vol. 1 (London, 1787), ch. 1
